test_title: PYST 03: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

Dr. Paramahamsa has been working / as a Assistant Professor / of Mathematics / in IIT Madras for five years.

options.text: in IIT Madras for five years

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect article usage before the term "**Assistant Professor**."
 
• The term "**Assistant Professor**" should be preceded by the article "**an**" instead of "**a**."
 
• The correct phrase should be "**as an Assistant Professor**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 1** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Dr. Paramahamsa has been working as an Assistant Professor of Mathematics in IIT Madras for five years."*
